documentSections.title: Exploration log 2
documentSections.content:
After debriefing the class d, fitting them with radio equipment they made entry into 860. This time instructed to always take the right turn when met with a fork in the path. 

After walking for approximately 2 minutes always taking the right turn, class D spotted a Shed, made out of wood. Class D made entry into the shed, it contained the following equipment: Axe, Hammer and Pliers. 

Class D reported the shed to be nothing out of the ordinary. Instructed to leave the shed and procced further into 860, Class D proceeded going further, to the same direction as before. 

After approximately 1 minute and 3 right turns later subject was met with a larger wooden house, the entrance was blocked with planks, using a window subject reported the house containing a purple key, although the only way to get in was via the blocked off entrance. Class D had no way of getting inside of the house to inspect the key, Subject proceeded on the path. 

After approximately 40 seconds later class d reports seeing a lone wooden door surrounded by concrete wall that expands beyond sight. Class D was instructed to use the blue key given at the start (Blue key used to make entry into 860) to attempt to open the wooden door. The blue key did not fit in the key hole and thus didnt open the wooden door. 

Class D was instructed to return back onto the path and procced to trace back from where they came from, after a few seconds subject encounters something abnormal and radio contact is lost, last words by the class d were “What the fuck” - [in a confused matter, rather then scared] , 

Class D - Deceased (Unconfirmed)
